description: List or aggregate vouchers for the company. Put type, dates, pagination, sort, search, branch, and voucherVersion on the query string. Optional filter fields go in the JSON body — do not send type only in the body. Part of the Export Invoices V2 APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour. Optional.

type.description: Voucher or list type. Send on the query string, not in the JSON body. Allowed values: sales, invoice, payment, receipt, credit note, debit note. Default: sales. Optional.

noteType.description: Credit/debit note subtype when type is a note list. Optional.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Optional.

sortBy.description: Field to sort by. Allowed values: voucherDate, dueDate, voucherNumber. Optional.

voucherCount.description: Voucher count query parameter. Default: 10. Optional.

fileType.description: Output file type. Default: xlsx. Optional.

voucherVersion.description: Use 2 for accounting-microservice voucher APIs (same as Giddh panel). Default: 2. Optional.

invoiceCount.description: Related invoice count hint for invoice list queries. Optional.

mail.description: When true, trigger mail export. Default: false. Optional.
